s0.ru: Число начинает с {start}. Делителей {n}, каждый не меньше 2: {divisors}. На шаге остаток от деления прибавляется к сумме остатков, а частное, округлённое вниз, становится новым числом. Каково частное в конце?
s0.en: The number starts at {start}. There are {n} divisors, each at least 2: {divisors}. At a step the remainder is added to the remainder sum, and the quotient rounded down becomes the new number. What is the final quotient?

s1.en: The number starts at {start}. There are {n} divisors, each at least 2: {divisors}. At a step the remainder is added to the remainder sum, and the quotient rounded down becomes the new number. What is the sum of the remainders?
